catalysts.headline: MIXED/CONFLICTING reports on the stock's reaction to the Q3 2026 print (kept verbatim, not reconciled): one source reports a ~2.07% premarket decline to $187.88 (well off the 52-week high of $296.44); another reports a ~3.0% premarket decline; a third (GuruFocus) reports a ~3.3% premarket GAIN, directly contradicting the first two. By 2026-10-29, sources describe the stock up ~1% intraday, closing around $203.32. Underlying driver, consistent across sources: adjusted EPS of $2.54 beat consensus (~$2.43-$2.44) but net sales of $1.29B missed the ~$1.32B consensus despite +16% YoY growth — a genuine beat-and-miss combination plausibly explaining the divergent characterizations (premarket dip on the revenue miss vs. recovery on the EPS beat/data-center backlog).

Generac reported Q3 2026 results before market open: record net sales of $1.29B (+16% YoY), GAAP net income $109M ($1.83/diluted share), adjusted net income $151M ($2.54/diluted share, beating the $2.44 consensus estimate), gross margin 39.9%, free cash flow $131.7M. Data-center product backlog grown to approximately $4.5 billion following the Amazon agreement and other wins (the Amazon deal itself still projects ~$2.4B of initial deliveries across 2027-2028). Maintained full-year 2026 net sales growth guidance in the mid-to-high-teens percent range; narrowed full-year adjusted EBITDA margin guidance to approximately 20.5%-21.0%.
Piper Sandler initiated coverage on GNRC with a Buy rating and a $303 price target.

Generac disclosed a long-term supply agreement to provide backup generators for Amazon data centers, with aggregate potential gross payments of up to $8 billion over the life of the arrangement and roughly $2.4 billion of initial deliveries expected across 2027-2028. As part of the deal, Generac issued a warrant to an Amazon subsidiary for up to 1,693,745 shares at a $200.9266 strike price (one source instead describes the initial vesting tranche as 300,000 shares, with the remainder vesting as payments/deliveries occur — see conflicts).
catalysts.impact: Shares were up about 34.5% in premarket trading on the announcement; Cantor Fitzgerald kept its rating and called it the firm's most important data-center-related news item

catalysts.headline: Amazon obtained the right to buy up to $340M of Generac stock as part of a $2.4B backup-generator supply deal for AI data centers
catalysts.impact: stock recorded a record single-session gain the following day

catalysts.headline: Generac reported Q2 2026 results before the open: EPS of $2.91 on revenue of $1.17 billion (+10.6% YoY), with Commercial & Industrial external net sales up ~29% YoY to $556 million; revenue came in slightly below some analyst expectations. Management cited a data-center backlog of $1.6 billion as of July 2026 and said tariff refunds helped margins and cash flow; the Sussex, WI plant was said to be on track to begin production ahead of schedule.
Jefferies reiterated a Buy rating on GNRC and kept its price target at $279 following the Q3 2026 print.
catalysts.source: Investing.com ('Jefferies reiterates Buy on Generac stock, keeps $279 target')

Q3 2026 adjusted-EPS consensus cited as either $2.43 or $2.44 by different sources.
